items.quote: Confirm that `VERCEL_TOKEN` is set and the header uses `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
items.why: Shows bearer header use only; nothing on oauth2 method.

items.quote: Vercel's IdP uses the OAuth 2.0 authorization framework, a widely adopted industry standard for securing and delegating access to resources on behalf of users.
items.why: Says Vercel uses OAuth 2.0 framework; no list of auth methods.

items.quote: For users to be able to use Sign in with Vercel in your application, they must have a Vercel account.
items.why: Says Sign in with Vercel needs an account; no token creation or free-tier gate.

items.quote: Use a Vercel access token to call the Vercel REST API with `curl`, then make the same request with `@vercel/sdk`.
items.why: Shows REST and SDK usage; says nothing on sdk_only or breadth.

items.quote: Vercel MCP is Vercel's official MCP server. It's a remote MCP with OAuth that gives AI tools secure access to your Vercel projects available at:
items.why: States it is Vercel's official, remote, OAuth MCP server; URL not in quote.

items.quote: Vercel MCP is available on all plans and your use is subject to Vercel's AI Product Terms.
items.why: Says available on all plans; does not state existence or official status.
